args.summary:
Modeled the 5×30 m precast small-box girder bridge (先简支后连续) as a 2D spine-beam, elastic beam-column idealization (MR-01), with continuous system (MR-05, no pier-column data → bearings on rigid supports).

Key decisions:
- Section: middle small-box girder integrated from the given geometry (h=1.6, b_top=2.40, t_tip=0.18, haunch 0.192/0.063, b_bottom=1.00, t_bot=t_top=0.18, t_web=0.20, web slope 1:4, chamfers 0.15×0.07) → A_single=1.139 m², I_single=0.3549 m⁴. Merged over 3 girders (MR-02): A=3.417 m², I=1.0648 m⁴.
- Material: C50 Ec=34500 MPa (JTG 3362 3.1.5); γ=26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60 4.2.1); dead load girder self-weight only, w=88.84 kN/m, m=9.056 t/m (MR-07).
- Bearings (MR-03/MR-04, JTG 3362 8.7): supports 0,1,3,4,5 = PTFE sliding, 6 per line (2/girder end × 3 girders), vertical spring Kv=8.518e6 kN/m, longitudinal free (Kh=0); support 2 = plain laminated elastomeric (fixed), longitudinal spring Kh=18000 kN/m. Shape factor S=10.714 for all.
- Live load (JTG D60 4.3.1): Class I, one-way, carriageway 8 m → 2 design lanes; ξ=1.0, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=320 kN per span (L0=30 m).

Results: fundamental vertical frequency f1=3.513 Hz → impact factor μ=0.2063 (JTG D60 4.3.2, 0.1767·ln f1 − 0.0157). Model built and passed L1/L2/L3 checks. Peak self-weight reactions ≈1053 kN at abutments and ≈3014 kN at the piers; live-load max positive moment ≈6882 kN·m (end spans), max negative support moment ≈−5094 kN·m. No unresolved issues.
